verdict.rationale: The evidence shows LocalAI can load models from the CLI (`local-ai run huggingface://...`, `local-ai run ollama://...`) and preload them via `--preload-models`. Nothing documents a CLI flag or setting for GPU layer offload or context length. Automatic GPU backend detection is an adjacent feature and does not show user control over offload or context size.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
